svg.text: 1. Runner: fit the five trunnions to the hub seats, mount the blades in numbered order, set all
blade angles, torque the bolting; balance the runner (G6.3).
2. Bulb: install the generator and the shaft seal inside the bulb (by the generator supplier);
couple the runner to the shaft; check run-out at the hub ≤ 0.2 mm.
3. Guide vanes: set the bulb in the duct on a jig with the axes aligned within 2 mm; position the 8
vanes at 45° and weld them to bulb and duct.
4. Check the tip clearance of 3 ± 1 mm at 8 positions by turning the runner by hand; record.
5. Pylon: weld or bolt the pylon to the duct frame; coat damaged areas.
6. Base: place the gravity base on the prepared river bed, level within 1:200; lower the unit and
bolt the pylon to the anchor plate.
7. Connect the export cable; commission: rotation by hand, insulation test, first run at low flow,
Blade and hub castings: chemistry, mechanical
0.5 bar soap test; 0.2 bar 1 h hold
H = hold point (work stops until accepted) · W = witness point · R = document review
ASSEMBLY SEQUENCE, INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN
From parts to an installed unit
TEACHING MODEL — materials, tolerances and wall thicknesses are assumptions. Not for construction.
